request: Analyze GSE310344 and GSE310849 for PMID 41736525 (Repeated Disuse Atrophy Imprints a Molecular Memory in Skeletal Muscle: Transcriptional Resilience in Young Adults and Susceptibility in Aged Muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis (young adults, n=9 with RNA-seq per time point)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 2-wk unilateral knee-brace immobilization (disuse atrophy), ~7 wk return to habitual ambulation (recovery), and 2-wk repeated immobilization on the muscle transcriptome; no exercise intervention is sampled
final.inclusion: Baseline/Atrophy/Recovery/Repeated Atrophy biopsies, n=9 each (FIG1 legend)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 median-of-ratios within Partek Flow (S2.14.p1); pairing handling not stated
final.exercise_content: Recovery = participants returned to their normal ambulatory activity (S2.3.p1); they were told to refrain from strenuous exercise 24 h before biopsies; the supervised resistance training was offered only AFTER the study and was not biopsied (S2.3.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1 defines the human design as immobilization -> habitual-activity recovery -> repeated immobilization. S2.14.p1 gives DESeq2 in Partek and the FDR<=5% and >=20% FC rule. S3.3.p1 gives DEG counts. No arm is an exercise bout or training programme.

checks: Human Skeletal Muscle, Homo sapiens, contact A.P. Sharples (author)
4 conditions x 9 participants = 36 samples, matching n=9 per timepoint (FIG1)
data_processing matches S2.14.p1 Partek/STAR hg38 pipeline

ownership.reasoning: GEO metadata organism, tissue, design and processing match the human arm of the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal the Library name in description (36/36 metadata matched; 4 extra matrix columns have no metadata). Time from condition/time; subject = participant.

matrix.recommended_method: limma on log2(CPM+1) (raw counts not deposited)

final.paper_input: raw counts into DESeq2 (S2.14.p1); only CPM deposited

matrix.reasoning: File name says CPM, 1.8% integer values, median ~1; no raw counts deposited.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the study manipulates disuse (knee-brace immobilization) and habitual-activity recovery; no sampled arm receives an exercise bout or training (S2.3.p1). The post-study resistance training was not biopsied. Treating recovery (return to normal ambulation) as exercise would change the paper's estimand.
design.subject: subject

candidates.reason_rejected: Recovery is return to habitual ambulation, not an exercise intervention; the paper frames it as recovery from disuse (S2.3.p1, S3.3.p1).
Valid disuse estimand but not an exercise effect, which the request asks for.

design.reasoning: Request is the exercise effect as the paper intends; the paper has no exercise arm. Refused at design.

discrepancies.disposition: would require a limma deviation; moot because the case is refused at design
